items.title: Ecolab (ECL) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Lift As Analysts Raise Targets
items.summary: Ecolab is back in focus after several Wall Street firms lifted their price targets into the US$344 to US$380 range, following the latest quarterly results and transaction updates. Analysts link these higher targets to a more constructive view on Ecolab's pricing power, its exposure to end markets seen as relatively attractive, and the contribution from CoolIT and Ovivo, while still flagging some volume and execution questions.
